purpose: Teach: エクアドル/リトル/リバー/ツイン/ニフティ/ポリス/サンデー/バックス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエクアドルの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'd read you that picture book about Ecuador.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Gentle rise on his name. Slight smile in the voice—she's noticed something sweet in what his father offered. Soft and observant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、リトルリーグに入りたいよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I want to join Little League.
lines.style: Bright, direct, earnest. Quick attack. Small boy's pride underneath the eagerness. Slight rise at the end—checking if she thinks it's a good idea.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリバー川沿いの公園に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to take you to the park by River Stream.
lines.style: Tender, unhurried. Gentle pause after his name. She's savoring these small kindnesses. Soft fade on the end—like she's tucking the information in gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ツインのアイス食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I had a twin ice cream with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, quick-flowing. Small joy bubbling up. Slight breathiness on 'twin'—excitement about the specificity. Quick ending, eager for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニフティな提案、つまり気の利いた提案をされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made a rather clever suggestion.
lines.style: Warm approval, slightly knowing. Gentle emphasis on 'clever.' Slower, more deliberate pace—she's clearly impressed by something thoughtful he did. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとザ・ポリスの曲聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I listened to The Police with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, quick. Pride in his voice—he's sharing something grown-up he did. Small-boy certainty. Quick taper at the end, waiting for her acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンデーモーニングの新聞を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was reading the Sunday morning paper.
lines.style: Calm, observant. Gentle, unmarked delivery—she's describing a quiet domestic moment she noticed. Slight warmth underneath. Soft, natural pace, trailing gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとラグビーのバックスの位置習ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad taught me the back positions in rugby.
lines.style: Bright, warm close. Quick attack, proud clarity. Small boy's confidence in learning something athletic. Slight rise at the end—looking for her smile of recognition. Genuine warmth.
